decisions.reason: Featured on the home page in its launch year, the sound-equipped candle arch has had only one season to show results, and keeping it in a seasonal catalogue costs little, so the option stays open.
The one-tier pyramid is a core traditional item made with existing workshop skills, so holding it costs little while its seasonal demand becomes clear.
As the flagship of the firm's new electronic music box direction, it anchors a platform of follow-on options, and its uncertain but potentially high value justifies keeping it.
This accessory platform only mentioned on the website extends the music box system cheaply, but its lower visibility makes it a likelier candidate for pruning if the system underperforms.
The Christmas motif platform is a low-cost add-on to the flagship whose value depends on music box uptake, which is still unresolved after one season.
The Dresden-themed pyramid suits a collectible regional niche and was shown on the home page, so with little cost to keep it the firm waits for more sales evidence.
